why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 86 covers avenues M 1/2, N, N 1/2, O; sheet 87 covers O, O 1/2, P, P 1/2. Ave O is the only shared avenue and lies at sheet 86's east edge and sheet 87's west edge. The address runs are exact complements on the one corridor: sheet 86's west frontage reads the even numbers 3904 3906 3908 3910 3912 3914 3916 3918 3920 3922 3924 3926 3928 for the 39th-40th block, then 4002 4004 south of 40th; sheet 87's east frontage reads the odd numbers 3903 3905 3907 3909 3911 3913 3915 3917 3919 3921 3923 3925 3927 for the same block, then 4001 4003. The cross-street run clinches it: 40th St ends ...1620 1622 1624 / 1619 1621 1623 on sheet 86 and resumes 1702 1704 1706 1708 / 1701 1703 1705 1707 on sheet 87 - the 1600/1700 hundred-block break falls exactly on this avenue, and both plates print the 40th St width '80''. One avenue west on sheet 86 is Ave N 1/2 (faces 2063/2274) and one east on sheet 87 is Ave O 1/2 (faces 1040/1250); neither is shared. Detection's candidates (86: 2589/1548/508; 87: 752/1750/2749) were discarded. Positions are the mid-line of the corridor: sheet 86 faces x=3055 and x=3277 -> 3166 (consistent with its avenue chain 168.5 / 1167.5 / 2168.5, spacing ~1000); sheet 87 faces x=37 and x=254 -> 146 (chain 146 / 1145 / 2145 / 3144).
